lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap using the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team's raw data API and exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, GeoJSON, KML, GeoPackage, CSV). AI-based analysis estimated that the 1.3 million mapped buildings represent approximately 39% of total building stock in Libya, with data currency assessed at an average age of 5 years.
